abilities.effect: The cavern collapses in a cave-in that deals 4d8+22 bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in the cavern (DC 30 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Collapse

hazard.description: The rubble shifts and the cavern ceiling collapses.
hazard.disable: DC 28 Crafting (expert) or DC 31 Survival (trained) to prop up the cavern ceiling without triggering a collapse.
hazard.name: Cave-In
